scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: Summer plans! We're going to stay ONE night in each place: a farm, a caravan… and a real lighthouse!

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the places to stay.

words.clue: A building with many rooms for guests.
You sleep in it when you go camping.
A little house on wheels that a car pulls.
A tall tower with a big light that helps ships at night.
A place in the countryside with animals and fields.
A person who stays in a hotel.

activities.title: Match the place with its best detail.

pairs.right: the sound of rain on the roof
the best cakes in the world

activities.title: Listen to the summer plan. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (planificando) y Maya (con la lista).
data.script: Ingrid: Summer adventure plan! Night one: the farm. We're going to help with the cows in the morning. … Maya: I'm going to take photos of the baby goats! … Ingrid: Night two: the caravan by the lake. Diego is going to cook sausages. … Maya: Night three is my favourite: the lighthouse! … Ingrid: Yes! The lighthouse keeper is Grandpa Sven's friend. We're going to sleep at the top, next to the great light. … Maya: And Kili is going to sleep outside, on the highest window. … Ingrid: Four friends, three nights, one great adventure. Pack your suitcases!
